summary: ING Groep N.V. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release providing a weekly progress update on its ongoing €1.1 billion share buyback programme announced on 30 October 2025. During the week of 13-17 April 2026, the company repurchased 915,231 shares at an average price of €24.63, for a total weekly consideration of €22.5 million. Cumulatively, 45.3 million shares have been repurchased at an average price of €23.44, representing ~96.5% completion of the programme's maximum value. The programme aims to reduce ING's share capital, consistent with routine capital return initiatives. No special situation event or triggering corporate action is present.
